name: Luganda
note: Reviewed by Patrick (Luganda speaker) on 2026-10-07. His grammar corrections are kept verbatim; figures he had written out in words were removed, because a template renders thousands of different cards and a spelled-out figure would be wrong on all but one. See numeralWords() in i18n.ts, which now refuses them.
